name: 迪佩什·查克拉巴蒂

identity.findings: Dipesh Chakrabarty（迪佩什·查克拉巴蒂），1948年生（在世），印度裔历史学家：加尔各答Presidency College（加尔各答大学）物理学荣誉理学士、印度管理学院加尔各答分校管理学研究生文凭、澳大利亚国立大学历史学博士（1984，自述导师D.A. Low）；先在墨尔本大学任教，1995年起转任芝加哥大学，现为历史系、南亚语言文明系与学院合聘的Lawrence A. Kimpton杰出服务教授；《属下研究》（Subaltern Studies）编者集体创始成员。与站内条目「迪佩什·查克拉巴蒂」为同一人，无重复条目；中文译名与站内键一致。生年1948仅核到图书馆目录检索摘要层（官方页未载生月）；出生地通记加尔各答（官方页未载）。
legacyIssues: legacy称「师从拉纳吉特·古哈——庶民研究学派的奠基人」：查氏自述博士导师为D.A. Low（洛），1980年正是Low为古哈在ANU设席；古哈到ANU时查氏已是博士生，两人1979年在英国相识；查氏称古哈为「teacher, guru, and friend」属非正式授业与私交，非学位导师关系
legacy称「先后在加尔各答大学获得学士与硕士学位」：官方页（SALC）仅载Presidency College物理学荣誉理学士与IIM加尔各答管理文凭；硕士学位无任何来源支持
legacy称「2004年获美国历史学会奖」：2004年实为当选美国人文与科学院院士（AMACAD官方档案页Elected 2004）；「2014年获博古睿哲学与文化奖」：2014年实为汤因比奖（Toynbee Prize），且博古睿哲学奖2016年才首颁，无任何获奖记载
legacy把2021年著作写作《气候的历史：人类世时代的资本与星球》：2021年书原题The Climate of History in a Planetary Age（芝加哥大学出版社）；「气候的历史」是2009年Critical Inquiry论文《The Climate of History: Four Theses》的题名，legacy把论文与书混为一谈
legacy概述称PE论证「民族、国家、进步、理性等概念均植根欧洲经验」并称其提出「非同一性」的历史书写：PE的关键表述是「历史化」（historicizing）携带祛魅空间、世俗时间、主权等欧洲假设（Princeton出版页、SEP殖民主义条目），「非同一性」非其术语
legacy称其早期文章为《庶民研究的若干问题》（1985）：查无此题名；其1992年成名论文为《后殖民性与历史的虚构：谁为「印度的过去」发言》（Representations 37, pp. 1-26），后整体成为PE第一章
legacy的life为空、concepts仅1条、bibliography仅1条书名、relations全部是「共同思想背景」式流派抽取（法农、弗莱雷、基哈诺、杜塞尔、恩古吉、姆班贝等无文献依据）——全部重写

sources.title: 查克拉巴蒂自述：《Remembering Ranajit Guha: My guru, my friend》（Indian Express, 2023-05-02）
sources.readScope: 全文通读。支持：古哈2023-04-28卒于维也纳，差数周满百岁；「Ranajitda and his wife Mechthild, an anthropologist, came to the Australian National University in 1980 when I was a doctoral student. My supervisor, D A Low, was instrumental in creating a position for him. I had met Ranajitda the year before in England and had been inducted into what became the famed circle of 'Subaltern Studies.'」；古哈在ANU不授课，查氏所受的是散步（Lake Burley Griffin）、咖啡与午餐中的非正式讲授；「He was both a teacher, a guru, and a friend」；古哈的读书法「you can't read a thinker on his or her own, you have to read backwards...to read Marx, you had to read Hegel; to read Derrida, you had to read Heidegger; to read Foucault, you needed to get back to Nietzsche」；古哈晚年转向孟加拉语写作；作者署名栏「He is also a founding member of the Subaltern Studies」。

sources.title: 《Provincializing Europe: Postcolonial Thought and Historical Difference》（Princeton UP, 2000）第1-2章扫描本（香港大学英文系托管，经Wayback存档；无文字层，42页本地OCR后通读）
sources.readScope: 第1章「Postcoloniality and the Artifice of History」（原书pp. 27-46）与第2章「The Two Histories of Capital」（pp. 47-71）OCR通读，引文以OCR校读、页码按扫描本页眉。第1章支持：开篇即自称「As a historian who is a member of the Subaltern Studies collective」，目的在「problematize the idea of 'Indians' 'representing themselves in history'」；p. 27「'Europe' remains the sovereign, theoretical subject of all histories, including the ones we call 'Indian,' 'Chinese,' 'Kenyan,' and so on」；p. 28「That Europe works as a silent referent in historical knowledge becomes obvious in a very ordinary way」及第三世界史家必引欧洲史家而无人回报的「两个日常症状」；小节「HISTORICISM AS A TRANSITION NARRATIVE」；p. 39引Meaghan Morris「a known history, something which has already happened elsewhere, and which is to be reproduced, mechanically or otherwise, with a local content」与「the project of positive un-originality」；「my hyperreal Europe will continually return to dominate the stories we tell」；「the denial of the bourgeois private and of the historical subject」与甘地例证。第2章支持：p. 51「a distinction that Marx made between two kinds of histories: histories 'posited by capital' and histories that do not belong to capital's 'life process.' I call them History 1 and History 2」及「I conclude this chapter by trying to open Marxian categories up to some Heideggerian ruminations」；p. 63-65：引《剩余价值理论》「posited by itself」→「Let us call this history—a past posited by capital itself as its precondition—History 1」；History 2为资本「encounters them as antecedents...not as antecedents established by itself, not as forms of its own life-process」（马克思的商品与货币为例）；「History 2s are thus not pasts separate from capital; they inhere in capital and yet interrupt and punctuate the run of capital's own logic」；「History 2s do not constitute a dialectical Other of the necessary logic of History 1」。导论未在本扫描本内（「first in Europe, then elsewhere」一语未能直接核对原文）。OCR对引文的拼写可靠性逐条目视校验过。

sources.title: Princeton University Press出版页：Provincializing Europe
sources.readScope: 整页。支持：系列Princeton Studies in Culture/Power/History；初版2000，新版（New Edition）2007-11-18（ISBN 9780691130019），电子书ISBN 9781400828654；出版方描述：「mythical figure of Europe」作为非西方现代性叙事的默认起点；「The very idea of historicizing carries with it some peculiarly European assumptions about disenchanted space, secular time, and sovereignty」；不合此标准则第三世界「either incomplete or lacking」；「every case of transition to capitalism is a case of translation as well」；新版加入回应批评者的前言（「globalizing European thought」）；作者简介行。页内未见「History 1/History 2」表述、无完整目录。

sources.title: Google Books条目页：The Climate of History in a Planetary Age（芝加哥大学出版社）
sources.readScope: 条目页通读。支持：University of Chicago Press, 2021/03/22, 292页；出版方描述：「Climate change, he argues, upends long-standing ideas of history, modernity, and globalization」「confront humanities scholars with ideas they have been reluctant to reconsider—from the changed nature of human agency to a new acceptance of universals」「we must see ourselves from two perspectives at once: the planetary and the global...the globe is a human-centric construction, while a planetary perspective intentionally de-centers the human」；目录：Intimations of the Planetary / I The Globe and the Planet / II The Difficulty of Being Modern / III Facing the Planetary / The Global Reveals the Planetary: A Conversation with Bruno Latour。正文未读。

sources.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy · Colonialism（第5节与书目）
sources.readScope: 第5节（decolonization与post-colonial theory）及书目通读。支持：PE被描述为「In his influential book Provincializing Europe, Chakrabarty argues that distinctively European concepts such as disenchanted space, secular time, and sovereignty inform the social sciences. When these standards are treated as universal, the third world is seen as incomplete or lacking」；后殖民理论谱系：萨义德《东方学》奠基、斯皮瓦克《属下能说话吗？》(1988)为「the second quasi-canonical contribution to the field」；Aijaz Ahmad批评斯皮瓦克「her essays exhibit contempt for materialism, rationalism, and progress, the core features of Marxism」；「Vivek Chibber (2013) and Dipesh Chakrabarty (2007) have taken up these issues」（马克思主义政治前提之辩）；书目列Chakrabarty 2007 Princeton与Guha/Spivak, Selected Subaltern Studies。注意：条目通篇未提霍米·巴巴。
